summary: Feed s083_single is degraded: 8.6% packet loss (186/2165 TCP packets) exceeds 1% threshold. IDS will have incomplete TCP reassembly and missed detections.

findings.root_cause: SPAN/mirror or packet broker is dropping packets under load (buffer/oversubscription). TCP analysis shows gaps/retransmissions indicating 8.6% missing data upstream of the IDS, while tool overload check is healthy, pointing to loss at the SPAN/broker, not the IDS itself.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs both directions and full payload for signature matching and stream reassembly. With 8.6% missing segments, flows are incomplete, signatures fail to fire, and attackers can evade detection via missed packets.

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless, out-of-band copy with no SPAN buffer drops or oversubscription. Replacing SPAN with TAP (and ensuring packet broker has sufficient buffer/capacity) eliminates the upstream loss causing TCP gaps.
